## Design and implementation

- [ ] The implementation follows the relevant architecture and coding standards.
- [ ] Scope is focused; unnecessary complexity and duplication were avoided.
- [ ] API, schema, and compatibility changes are documented.
- [ ] Database migrations and data-impacting changes are addressed.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] Authentication and authorization are correct for affected operations.
- [ ] Inputs are validated and outputs are handled safely.
- [ ] Sensitive data and secrets are protected.
- [ ] Dependencies and external integrations were considered.
- [ ] Security checklist completed if the change is security-sensitive.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or sensitive user data are included in this PR.

## Testing and verification

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated.
- [ ] Integration / end-to-end tests added or updated where appropriate.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests pass.
- [ ] Failure and edge cases were considered.
- [ ] Manual verification steps and results are provided where needed.

## Operations and rollout

- [ ] Logging, metrics, and alerts are adequate for the change.
- [ ] Configuration and environment variables are documented.
- [ ] Deployment and rollback implications are understood.
- [ ] Feature flag or staged rollout considered where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation and runbooks updated where needed.
